blocking.title: Phantom sea battles flood the history: a battle with no row and no fire logs 'fought at sea: lost 0 ships, 0' daily for months (seed 2609 year 21: 288 of 294 battles lose no ship, 145 Norway/Sweden vs UK at one point in 144 days; seed 6113 years 21-30: 687 of 722, Mongolia vs Japan 524 at one point); in the page the 'battle' is a 720-man Norwegian transport in Oslofjord against 22 British fleets stacked 17 cells away that never close (contradicts PLAN 7.19a)
blocking.fix: Make out-of-reach fleets close and fight, or have no battle: do not start or log a sea battle no weapon can reach, nor re-form one daily at the same point with zero losses.

blocking.title: AI nuclear strikes chase retreating armies across empty ground in weekly chains, told only by civilian dead: seed 2609's Soviet Union strikes China every 7 days along one line, 10,847 -> 1,373 -> 168 -> 24 dead and 10,862 -> ... -> 22 (utilities 0.22-0.83); Tibet 10,838 -> 18,190 -> 120 -> 24; seed 9901 18 strikes on China in 2 years; seed 4483 Germany hits one Canadian point twice 90 days apart (5,620 then 439 dead, utility 0.98); the player reads 'struck China with an atomic bomb: 24 dead'
blocking.fix: Weigh a target by what a burst there destroys and refuse places where the previous nearby strike found almost nothing; do not re-strike a fleeing army weekly; tell the player the men and equipment a strike destroyed, not only civilian dead.
